The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Local Government Notifications
SECTION No. 66c (2) LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)NOTICE OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE COUNCIL

I, W. M. Ruwan Wijesinghe, Commissioner of Local Government of North Central Province, by virtue of the power vested on me under the Section No.66c of Chapter No.262 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance amended by No. 22 of 2012 of the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, do hereby notify that the first meeting of Kebithigollewa Pradeshiya Sabha of Anuradhapura District of North Central Province will be held on 13.06.2025 at 2.30 p.m. at the council hall of Kebithigollewa Pradeshiya Sabha.
W. M. Ruwan Wijesinghe, Commissioner of Local Government. Department of Local Government,North Central Province, 02nd June 2025.
